items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think when we interviewed Louie Nelson... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I'm mixed up.

ctx.x: The trombone was, I think it was still August Russo.
I never knew him, I guess. I think when we interviewed Louie Nelson, who said he'd played with them for… No, no, that was mixed up. Louie Barberin?
